name: gateway-rocketchat
description: Rocket.Chat gateway. POSTs to <site>/api/v1/chat.postMessage with personal-access-token headers (X-Auth-Token + X-User-Id). Stdlib-only.

commands.send: Send a message to a Rocket.Chat channel/user (positional: target text)
commands.status: Show whether the bot site / token / user-id are configured
